description: Default capabilities for the main Ogmara window

permissions.comment: Native desktop: users connect to their OWN self-hosted / LAN nodes over plaintext http (e.g. http://host:41721), so http AND https on any host/port must be allowed. The web-client SSRF concern that motivated dropping plaintext http (audit B4.6/W2) does NOT apply to a native app — the HTTP plugin is reached only from local app code, validateNodeUrl still runs, and the signer attaches only to a user-selected node. Narrowing to https-only broke http node access ('url not allowed on the configured scope') → discovery/WS retry storm; reverted 2026-06-08.
